findings: E402 lint regression: 21 `noqa: E402` comments were stripped from `scenario_runner.py` (9 occurrences) and `src/api/fastapi_app.py` (12 occurrences) during merge conflict resolution. These files intentionally inject the project root into `sys.path` before importing `src.*` modules. Restore the `# noqa: E402` suffix on all imports following `sys.path.insert()` in both files.

Migration ordering dependency: Migration 005 (dashboard columns) depends on columns created by 003 (P2P) and 004 (temperature), but there's no enforcement mechanism. If migrations run out of order or 003/004 are skipped, queries will fail. Add a comment header to 005_dashboard.sql stating 'Requires 003_p2p.sql and 004_temperature.sql' and document the required sequence in a migrations README.

Test suite blocked: The environment has a scipy/numpy Python 3.13 incompatibility (`ValueError: All ufuncs must have type numpy.ufunc`) preventing test execution. This is pre-existing and unrelated to the merge, but it blocks verification that the 59 collected tests (including 2 new P2P test files with 418 lines and 1 temperature test file with 239 lines) actually pass. Downgrade to Python 3.11 or update scipy before the next CI run.

Verification doc inaccuracy: `.agents/tasks/verification.md` claims 'Ran `ruff check ... --ignore E501,E402 --fix` ... Result: All checks passed (0 errors)' but actually running `ruff check src/ tests/ scenario_runner.py --select E,F,W --ignore E501` (without ignoring E402, per the original task requirement) shows 21 E402 errors. The verification step appears to have silenced E402 rather than fixing it, contradicting the requirement to fix ~80 pre-existing errors.
